checks.acceptance: Create, rez, select, move, rotate, resize and edit basic objects through Firestorm

checks.acceptance: Clean stop/start restores region objects, inventory and avatar state without repair
checks.windows: Both Firestorm clients log out, server exits with STOPPED, and both log back in after restart. Three viewer-created objects retain UUIDs, names, owners and positions; the copied inventory item and Second Only Preview Folder reappear in the inventory UI; both avatars render clothed automatically. Isolated protocol check additionally verifies flushing an appearance update before its delayed save
checks.linux: Both real Firestorm clients log out; Linux Docker server exits with STOPPED and code 0. Same volume restarts, both accounts relogin clothed and mutually visible, and both render the restored edited cube. Exact UUID/name/owner/position/scale/quaternion, inventory copy, appearance records and region cache ID survive. Second inventory displays its saved item; First search returns no item. Last avatar positions remain saved. No startup map warning Final follow-up clean restart preserves both exact cube transforms, inventory and appearance; two-account protocol check receives both restored objects and mutual avatar updates. No additional GUI Firestorm run for that final follow-up.
